definition: a place where persons are locked up for punishment
description: Tall metal gates topped with coiled razor wire swing open at sunset. Men walk out one by one carrying their belongings in cardboard boxes, past a uniformed officer standing in the gateway. Families waiting on the road outside rush forward; a woman throws her arms around a grey-bearded man and sobs, and soon the whole road is filled with couples and families holding each other in the low orange light.

en.question: What is the grey-bearded man carrying?
